author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260512T050614Z-1940543
text: Parent epic for the RFC 6125 hostname-binding work. The pkix-identity half (PKIX-fmtv.11.1) shipped 2026-05-11 with 44 tests covering RFC 6125 §6.4. The pkix-chain wrapper half (PKIX-fmtv.11.2) is blocked on PKIX-fmtv.7 (wrapper-set decision, human-labeled). Labeling this epic 'human' so it does not re-surface at the top of bd ready every session. Once .7 resolves, drop the 'human' label and the loop will pick up .11.2 automatically. Alternatively, if .11.1 is deemed sufficient, close this epic and PKIX-fmtv.11.2 directly.
